reports.title: BillionToOne Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Raises 2026 Revenue Guidance

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: BillionToOne now expects full year 2026 total revenue of $460.0 million to $470.0 million, representing growth of 51% to 54% compared to full year 2025. This compares to the company's previous guidance of $450.0 million to $465.0 million.
BillionToOne also expects to operate the business such that it will continue to generate profitability similar to current levels, even with significant continued investments.
